values.en: The map $(t,x)\mapsto(t,H(t,x))$ is continuous, so its composite with $G$ is jointly continuous. At time $i=0,1$ its value is $g_i(f_i(x))$. The argument order is $G,H$, with the outer homotopy first.
values.zh-CN: $(t,x)\mapsto(t,H(t,x))$ 连续，与 $G$ 复合即得联合连续性。时间 $i=0,1$ 的值为 $g_i(f_i(x))$。实参次序为 $G,H$，外层同伦在前。
